scope: Input-only scorer preparation and scored-ledger summarizer implementation; no E20 answer grids read, no network, no GPU.

official_source.evidence: Existing 020 scoring prediction-freeze files and progress record use this immutable revision. No local official Git checkout is currently selected; existing scorer can fetch only matched task files after prediction freeze.

command_notes: Run only after solver output artifacts have been frozen; the scorer also hashes all input predictions before any gold read.
Add --prediction B1=PATH and --prediction B2=PATH to score three policies once when their frozen files exist.
The full original E20 manifest remains the denominator, including missing/invalid/placeholder queries.
Official input/version mismatch is unresolved and separately counted, never silently made incorrect or omitted from the original planned denominator.
Raw .bz2 candidate files are not directly accepted as --candidate-pool; wrap ranked exports in policy -> query-key -> candidate-row maps if using that scorer option.

summarizer.syntax_status: AST parse passed; not yet run against new E20 scoring artifacts
outputs: Each policy: query micro EM@2, fully matched full-task exact, validity/missing statuses, distinct slots, [[0]] heuristic counts, optional source-candidate coverage.
All ordered policy pairs: new/lost/net queries, micro EM delta, gained/lost keys and task IDs, baseline second-slot-exclusive losses.
required_ledger_metadata: policies.{name}.exact / attempt_1_exact / attempt_2_exact on matched rows
metadata_limitations: Ledger both_placeholder is a value heuristic for [[0]] in both slots, not proof of model provenance.
The new V1 candidate export is a direct query-key -> ranked unique grid rows map; --candidate-pool B0=PATH handles it directly.
Without source candidate exports, the ledger cannot identify one filled [[0]] slot versus a genuine generated [[0]] answer, or distinguish which source won an ensemble slot.
Current scoring ledger lacks routing/source-selection timing; routing opportunity-cost and wall-clock analysis need the run/candidate provenance separately.

manual_existing_scored_ledger_replay.source: Existing frozen C24 scored ledger; no new gold read

v1_export_cautions: Do not use V1 validate_submission task-weighted count as the Kaggle query metric.
Keep all raw guesses until score_kgmon aggregation: frequency is part of ranking, so early grid dedup loses votes.
Final candidate-pools may deduplicate grids only after ranking; top two unique rows correspond to final generated answer slots.
Original V1 leaves [[0]] in the second slot if only one candidate exists; preserve coverage provenance.
Decode artifacts are numpy-containing .bz2 pickles and require faithful conversion to rectangular integer grids; raw saved pickles are not score-ready submission JSON.
Retain all 27 E20 queries in original order; missing queries stay placeholders/failures and do not reduce the planned denominator.
